frame_source: three_d live run (same card/frame for both tables)
threshold_policy: 连续帧跳变首次在 P4 语境量化，无历史外部锚，不设放行线；只报告分布，结论结合看图给出。唯一数值上界 D_static 由两版表全量 284 帧独立复算得到，不是拍脑袋阈值。
phase_duration_exclusions: turn 1 discard: recorded during intro (3.75s intro included)
non-draw turns add HITSTOP_S=0.24 to resolve wall time
